story: Ayesha here. Swiftkart has not refunded Rs 3,499 for a cancelled order I placed on 20 October 2026. I live in Lucknow.

facts.user_goal: Get a refund of Rs 3,499 for a cancelled order
missing: Date the refund was requested or refused

rules.name: consumer_limitation
rules.message: File your consumer complaint before 20 Oct 2028 (712 days left). This counts 2 years from 20 Oct 2026 (your purchase date - counted from the earliest possible day, to be safe). Don't wait for the last date. Sending a letter or calling the helpline does NOT pause this clock.

facts_used.start_basis: purchase date (earliest possible start, to be safe)

rules.label: Last date to file your consumer complaint

rules.name: forum_and_fee
rules.message: You paid Rs 3,499, so the complaint goes to the District Consumer Commission, with no filing fee. You can file in the district where you live or work, online at e-jagriti.gov.in. You don't need a lawyer to file.
rules.label: Where to file

rules.name: free_first_steps
rules.message: Two free steps often work first: (1) a written complaint to the seller's or platform's grievance officer, (2) the National Consumer Helpline: call 1915 or WhatsApp 8800001915.
rules.label: Try these first

answer.summary: You paid Rs 3,499 to Swiftkart. You cancelled the order, but they did not refund you. You can file a complaint with the District Consumer Commission. There is no fee to file because your amount is under Rs 5 lakh. You have until 20 October 2028 to file. You can also call 1915 or WhatsApp 8800001915 for free help.

support.text: You are a consumer because you bought goods for personal use for Rs 3,499.
support.reason: The law defines a 'consumer' as any person who buys any goods for a consideration which has been paid or promised, etc., and includes any user of such goods other than the person who buys such goods for consideration. The sentence applies this to a person who bought goods for personal use for Rs 3,499, which falls within the definition.

support.text: A cancelled order that is not refunded is an unfair trade practice.
support.reason: The law text states that refusing to take back or withdraw defective goods or to refund the consideration after selling goods is an unfair trade practice within a stipulated period, and in absence of stipulation, within thirty days. The sentence states that a cancelled order that is not refunded is an unfair trade practice, which is directly supported by the law text.

support.text: You can file your complaint in the District Commission for Lucknow.
support.reason: The law text states that a complaint shall be instituted in a District Commission within the local limits of whose jurisdiction the opposite party... resides or carries on business. The sentence applies this to Lucknow, which is a District Commission, so it is supported by the law text.

support.text: You can file your complaint in the District Commission for Lucknow.
support.reason: The law text provides pecuniary jurisdiction limits (Rs 50 lakh for District Commission, etc.), not geographical jurisdiction. It does not say that you can file in the District Commission for Lucknow. The sentence adds a geographical condition (Lucknow) that is not in the law text.

support.text: There is no filing fee for your Rs 3,499 claim.
support.reason: The law text states 'No fee where the consideration paid is up to Rs 5 lakh.' The sentence applies this to a Rs 3,499 claim, which is within the limit, so it is supported.

support.text: You have until 20 October 2028 to file your complaint.
support.reason: The law text states that a complaint shall not be admitted unless filed within two years from the date on which the cause of action has arisen. The sentence adds a specific date (20 October 2028) and implies that this is the deadline, but the law text does not specify any particular date; it only provides a two-year period from the cause of action. The sentence adds a specific date that is not in the law text.

draft_notes:
How to send it:
1. Find their correct address in the invoice, order page, or the seller's 'grievance officer' details on the website/app.
2. Fill every [FILL] slot. Remove anything that isn't true - only state facts you can prove.
3. Send by Speed Post and keep the receipt and the tracking proof of delivery. Also send a copy by email or WhatsApp and keep a screenshot.
4. Wait 15 days. Sending this letter does NOT stop any legal time limit - file your claim/complaint before the deadline shown, even if they haven't replied.
5. Free help to check the letter: legal aid 15100 or Tele-Law 14454.

Laws this letter relies on: Consumer Protection Act, 2019, s.69 (Two-year limitation and condonation); Consumer Protection Act, 2019, s.34(2) (Where to file: District Commission); Consumer Protection Act, 2019, s.35(1) (Who may file a complaint; e-filing)
